body:
Owner challenged first-pass confidence and prioritized APIs. Revised plan preserves one sprint/40 mandatory work tickets/one acceptance, but no longer implies full-kit API feasibility is established. UI-only/unavailable operations return explicit no-effect/unavailable and do not count as verified coverage.

Deeper research: docs/research/modding-mcp-findings.md; evidence/modding-mcp/managed-api-audit.json; primary-source-api-audit.json; ui-resource-tool-audit.json; native-handler-observations.json and native-handler-rea.json. Fresh managed CIL distinguishes save callbacks/undo registration/runtime setters from authoring. Native REA proves command-registration and Qt save/publish wiring, not handler argument contracts, invocation or persistence. Sprite generation has a shipped public library entry; FontAtlas remains unresolved. Existing pinned SDK is a bounded reuse candidate, and local run30840 proves one animation only. No new live engine tests or product implementation occurred.

Acceptance now uses a reconciled per-operation denominator and separate declared/traced/invoked/verified levels, with independent output checks and cold reload for durable writes. Independent review fixed a recovery-proof ordering conflict and clarified that verified native adapters may count. File-writing adapters remain separately labeled candidates pending owner's coverage preference; they are never represented as direct engine APIs.

Source/install/repair/uninstall, dependency pins/licenses and alternate-checkout reinstall remain mandatory repo-owned deliverables. No execution run was started.
